text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up: EdiHealth onboarding looks stuck. Noted low API traffic after initial POC. Renewal in 28 days, paying annual. Concern: they'll downgrade or churn.

Ajay Patel: Seen the logs — their connector kept failing auth for 2 days. I re-provisioned keys yesterday, they sent back test calls. Suggest: short enablement session + API review.

Liam O'Neill: +1. Can we offer a 2-week extension on success metrics window and a sandbox env with preloaded sample data? If they hit X inference/sec we keep standard plan.

Samira Gomez: I'll own the customer call. Proposed agenda: 1) quick triage 2) walkthrough of SDK usage 3) success metric definition 4) next steps. When can we do it?

Maria Chen: Today 3pm PT? @Ajay @Liam can you join for 20m? Also capture feedback via this form: https://redwoodinference.io/cs/feedback-form

Ajay Patel: I can make 3–3:30. I'll bring logs and the exact failure trace. Quick snippet I ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/velox/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \
 -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":10}'
```
Error was 401 -> rotated keys fixed it.

Harper (onboard-bot): Reminder: EdiHealth trial credits expire in 6 days. Auto-email scheduled.

Liam O'Neill: Also propose a downgrade-safety option if they can't meet throughput: reduce to S1 with preserved KV cache, prorated credits, and 30-day re-upgrade window. Should we document as action item?

Samira Gomez: Yes — I'll prepare a one-pager and the 'save plan' doc. Include triggers: stalled >7 days OR <10% expected API usage -> offer P1 enablement + S1 downgrade path.

Maria Chen: Capture this as quick churn play: "onboard-stall rapid save"
Action items:
- Samira: host call + one-pager (due today EOD)
- Ajay: list of auth/log artifacts + temporary sandbox creds (due today noon)
- Liam: draft downgrade SOW and pricing bullets (due tomorrow)
- Maria: open a renewal flag in Gainsight + tag CS Lead

Samira Gomez: Noted. Logging minutes in the account doc and will @ops to trigger the email. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: Thanks team — we'll sync at 3. If anything changes ping here.
